questionText: Under Taylor's differential piece rate system, the standard output is 50 units per day. The wage rate is Rs. 10 per unit for output below standard and Rs. 12 per unit for output at or above standard. Worker X produces 45 units and Worker Y produces 55 units. What are the daily earnings of Worker X and Worker Y respectively?

options.text: Worker X = Rs. 540, Worker Y = Rs. 600
options.mistakeAnalysis: Student error: Misidentifying principle or calculation error.

options.text: Worker X = Rs. 450, Worker Y = Rs. 660

options.text: Worker X = Rs. 450, Worker Y = Rs. 550
options.mistakeAnalysis: Student error: Inaccurate conceptual application.

options.text: Worker X = Rs. 500, Worker Y = Rs. 660

detailedSolution: Worker X is below standard (45 units): earns 45 * Rs. 10 = Rs. 450. Worker Y is at/above standard (55 units): earns 55 * Rs. 12 = Rs. 660. The difference of Rs. 210 strongly incentivizes achieving standard.

solution.quick: Option (B) is correct: Worker X = Rs. 450, Worker Y = Rs. 660
solution.concept: NCERT Class 12 Business Studies: Principles of Management - Principles and Techniques of Management.
solution.detailed: Worker X is below standard (45 units): earns 45 * Rs. 10 = Rs. 450. Worker Y is at/above standard (55 units): earns 55 * Rs. 12 = Rs. 660. The difference of Rs. 210 strongly incentivizes achieving standard.
